# Chat-app packs

One folder per role agent, for chat apps that don't install plugins (Claude Projects, ChatGPT custom GPTs, Microsoft Copilot agents and similar).

1. Paste **`INSTRUCTIONS.md`** into the project / GPT / agent instructions (each is under 8,000 characters).
2. Upload **`KNOWLEDGE.md`** and your filled-in **`business-context.md`** as knowledge files.
3. Start with low-risk tasks and review every draft before acting on it.
